routes.title: Chat & inline execution cards
routes.before: Replaces the earlier conversation specimen; #conversations remains an alias.
routes.layout: Conversation rail, compact welcome heading, retained Swap/Supply prompts, allocation comparison form, restrained transcript, persistent composer, application action card and separate shared review.
behavior: Prompt suggestions fill the composer; sending an action creates a typed local specimen.
Missing amount/asset and ambiguous Sentora products request clarification. Unsupported venue actions never silently change venue.
Only validated application events may create native action cards in production. Model prose stays escaped/inert.
Preparation, review, blocked, expired, wallet mismatch, signature, submission, reconciliation, partial completion and confirmed states remain distinct.
Stop response does not cancel a prepared plan. Dismiss plan is a separate control.
No automatic spending threshold, delegated signer or mandatory extra caps.
Deposit cards and the shared review keep venue-specific withdrawal conditions visible.

allocation_prompt.placement: Chat welcome state, replacing Compare lending venues and Understand withdrawal timing
allocation_prompt.removed_from: Research / DeFi capital, asset and horizon strip

fields.capital: Positive decimal string; commas accepted and normalized without floating-point conversion

behavior: Compare with Nest submits a read-only comparison prompt using the exact selected amount, asset and horizon.
Invalid or zero amounts stay in the form with an associated error and focus.
The comparison creates no financial action card and cannot sign or submit a transaction.
Selections persist during this page session and return when starting a new conversation.
Private amounts remain out of URLs. Production binds the comparison context to canonical network/asset identity and current source observations.
allocation_prompt.production: Keep comparison intent separate from financial preparation; connect Chat to validated application comparison results.

routes.title: Markets & MCP read catalog
routes.layout: Four source-family cards, catalog counts, venue market table and searchable/paginated MCP operation/skill cards.
behavior: Four Research tabs: DeFi, RWAs, Markets, Venue map. Saved remains a utility route.
Venue markets separate aggregator, lending protocol, vault platform, curator and product roles.
MCP read catalog lists all 60 operations and 20 skills from the pinned public manifest, with 202 section identifiers available in its data.
Search, family/type filters, pagination and JSON export operate over the actual collected catalog.
Snapshot time, source-fetched time, retrieval time and runtime verification remain separate.
A catalog entry does not establish a working endpoint, live market data, liquidity or execution permission.
bindings: Server-side bounded Raven catalog projection through the existing two-wrapper adapter
Guest fallback: pinned public manifest, labeled as snapshot; no OAuth token in browser

routes.title: Venue map
routes.layout: Grouped network or grid for Spot/Lending/Vaults, eight venue identity cards, source-family trunk, contextual inspector.
behavior: Search venue names/read coverage and filter by category; selection opens read/action/exit summaries.
All eight integration design records have a detail page; availability remains pending deployment verification.
Raven is a research source. Native adapters provide amount-specific state, simulation and confirmed outcomes.
Curators and platform routes can share one canonical vault; they are not additive TVL or separate user positions.
bindings: Raven catalog metadata for research-source coverage only

routes.title: Venue detail
routes.before: New dynamic venue route, reachable for every integration target.
routes.layout: Identity, network availability, read groups, supported design actions, exit disclosure, source boundaries and references.
behavior: Parameter selects Soroswap, Blend, Templar, XOXNO, DeFindex, Upshift, Gami Labs or Sentora.
Separate published research, adapter reads and transaction preparation authority.
Offer the relevant manual form or chat context without including private amounts in share URLs.
Product/deployment verification gates live actions.

routes.title: Market detail & read inspector
routes.layout: Market header, policy context, amount presets, comparable route bars or lending/vault terms, underlying composition, assets/identity and read inspector.
behavior: Spot offers 100/1,000/10,000 XLM fixture comparisons; route output changes with the selected amount.
Review in chat carries the exact requested amount via in-memory draft, never a URL amount parameter.
Lending/vault variants preserve native risk, capacity, fees, settlement and missing data.
Read inspector distinguishes requested/succeeded/empty/partial/stale/error with provenance in production; preview shows Not requested.
No synthetic orderbook, fake ledger ID, fabricated receipt link or unconditional live-status badge.
bindings: Native protocol/API/RPC read results and per-read provenance
Shared action review and application plan lifecycle

sources.observed: Prompt fill, safe recorded approval replay, preparing/awaiting-approval card and separate Review & sign control.
23-row demo venue catalog, category/layer/network filters, published read/build counts and venue detail dialog.
Search/filter market table with price/cost/liquidity/status and pair drill-down.
Size-aware best execution, pool/book comparison, asset/issuer facts and request inspector. XRPL-specific elements are adapted to Stellar.
Two tools, four source families, structured success/error envelopes, source/as-of caveats. Authenticated runtime access not invoked.

authority: Published research context is not an executable quote. Preserve Pi runtime and Nest application-owned preparation, policy, approval, signature, submission and confirmation.
responsive: Chat transcript scrolls in its own row; composer remains visible without overlaying the transcript.
No redundant assistant launcher on full Chat; contextual drawer remains on other routes.
Venue graph collapses into grouped cards on narrow layouts.
Catalog tables scroll within their container; source cards stack and maintain text labels.
integration_fields: read groups and typed operation IDs
acceptance: All four Research tabs are reachable from both existing research screens.
Every venue row/graph selection leads to the corresponding venue or market detail.
The catalog exposes 60 operations, 20 skills and all 202 section identifiers without implying runtime verification.
Chat exact amounts reach the shared review and remain strings at the boundary.
Preparation and stale/mismatch/blocked cards cannot sign or submit.
Manual forms remain available if AI fails.
No secrets, signed payloads, private context or wallet amounts are placed in URLs.
